note: Baseline from the P1-03 remediation pass (2026-08-02): Go/PHP/.NET SDK base images bumped to their latest published builds, Go additionally to a currently-supported minor (was 1.22, EOL), apt-get upgrade added to every Dockerfile, and an unused ImageMagick suite removed from the Rust image - a combined 45% reduction (2508 -> 1367 CRITICAL/HIGH) verified by live Trivy scans, not estimated. What remains here is the baseline: mostly Linux kernel-header CVEs (linux-libc-dev - kernel code that never executes inside a container, and a mandatory transitive dependency of libc6-dev/build-essential, confirmed not removable without breaking cgo/native-extension compilation) and Debian perl-tooling CVEs (perl/perl-base/perl-modules/libperl5.x - a mandatory transitive dependency of adduser/debconf, confirmed not removable). CI fails on any CRITICAL/HIGH finding NOT in this list (a genuinely new vulnerability) or once expires_at passes (forces periodic re-triage instead of silent indefinite acceptance) - see docker/check_vuln_baseline.py. | 2026-08-20 re-triage: 195 newly-disclosed CRITICAL/HIGH finding(s) added against packages already in the accepted risk categories above (Debian security-patch lag on the OS base layer, none with a published fixed_version at triage time - see docker/vuln-baseline/README or check_vuln_baseline.py for the no-fix-available handling). Findings with an actual available fix were deliberately excluded and left failing CI - see the PR this baseline update shipped in for the list; those need a real dependency/version bump, not baseline acceptance.
